subject.title: feat(macos): Quick Chat power features — voice dictation, paste-to-app, model/reasoning control

question: Should Quick Chat ship session-persistent model selection and Accessibility-gated paste-to-app as default power controls, once the paste lookup and native proof are complete?
rationale: This is a broad user-facing macOS feature expansion with a persisted session effect and cross-app automation boundary; patch correctness alone does not establish permanent product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the feature set
options.body: Keep the proposed controls, require the concrete paste repair and redacted native proof, then complete normal macOS owner review.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Land only the independently approved Quick Chat improvements and move session model controls or paste automation to separate owner-reviewed PRs.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause the PR until a macOS owner confirms the desired Quick Chat power-feature scope and permission UX.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the feature set
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed controls, require the concrete paste repair and redacted native proof, then complete normal macOS owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to this contributor and is framed as an extension of prior Quick Chat work, though the feature-history attribution remains low confidence.
